A Deliberately Complex Synthetic Firm Panel

fhk_complex_example.Rd

A teaching dataset derived from fhk_example. It contains an industry mover, a zero-weight row, a missing alternative productivity value, and a group observed at only one endpoint. It is intended for demonstrating explicit audit policies, not for a default one-line decomposition.

Usage

fhk_complex_example

Format

A data frame with 21 rows and the same 10 variables documented in fhk_example.

Source

Generated by data-raw/generate_example_data.R.

Examples

data(fhk_complex_example)
subset(fhk_complex_example, employment == 0 | is.na(productivity_alt))
#>    firm_id year      industry productivity productivity_alt employment
#> 10       C 2011 Manufacturing         3.55             3.56          0
#> 14       H 2011      Services         3.00               NA         55
#>    global_share within_industry_share first_active_year last_active_year
#> 10    0.0000000             0.0000000              2008             2015
#> 14    0.1222222             0.2037037              2011             2015
